messages:
harry: Thanks for sticking around for the infra segment. Opening a follow-up thread for specific Qs on APAC GPU capacity, autoscaler tuning, and customer-facing comms. Drop short questions here.

leah: Quick one 1: when you say 'bias allocation to APAC', does that imply well steal bursts from other regions or only unassigned capacity?

devops: Its exclusively from unassigned/hosted pooled capacity. We will not take reserved Dedicated capacity. If theres a potential conflict well flag accounts to SEs before reallocating anything.

product-eng: Is there a hard cutoff for switching from "bias" to "zone reservation"? Product teams need to know when traffic could be constrained.

devops: Were tracking two signals: (A) sustain utilization > 85% for 12h in a region, (B) predicted shipment shortfall < 10% buffer for next 14 days. When both true we move to reservation mode and surface to leadership + sales ops.

sasha: For the autoscaler, curious about latency SLAs when we reroute cross-region. Do we tag requests so downstream metrics can split local vs cross-region latency?

devops: Yes  we emit an "infra.routing" tag with values {local, nearby, cross-region, quantized-fallback}. Dashboards will be updated to show p50/p95 for each path.

harry: Ops-bot posted an event during the all-hands; can you paste the exact event id so engineers can query it?

ops-bot: event-id: infra-autoscale-1890001297; summary: cross-region fallback triggered for hosted-apac-prod  93 requests rerouted to eu-west-1.

leah: On quantized fallbacks  what's our rollback policy if generation quality drops? we can't silently degrade embeddings for search.

devops: Canary rollout only on non-critical traffic first (<=3% sample). We run automated embedding drift checks (cosine similarity windows) and automated canary health gates. If drift exceeds 0.07 average drop, we auto-rollback the variant and open an incident for manual review.

product-eng: Will you document the quantization compatibility matrix? some older model variants break structured output.

devops: Yes. We'll publish a compatibility table and mark which endpoints should never use quantized fallbacks unless explicitly opted in.

sasha: For customers requesting APAC isolation, what's the expected lead time and price implications?

devops: Typical lead time: 2-4 weeks for reserved pools depending on availability. We will require either a committed reservation or a short-term surcharge to prioritize capacity; pricing will be determined case-by-case and communicated by sales ops.

harry: Communications  can we get a short blurb for the public infra page and a customer template for region-lock requests? Product needs both for in-product messaging.

devops: Drafts in progress. Blurb will call out: "We are temporarily biasing hosted capacity to APAC while additional GPU shipments arrive (expected stages mid-June and mid-July). Customers may request region isolation; contact sales or file a region-lock support ticket." Template will be added to the sales playbook by EOD tomorrow.

leah: Autoscaler tuning: what are the warm pool sizes per region by default?

devops: Default warm reservoir: critical routes: 4 GPUs, standard routes: 2 GPUs. We'll expose policy knobs for tenants with high-latency sensitivity.

product-eng: One more: any change to the soft quota limits or token rate limiting during this bias window? we have customers worried about sudden throttles.

devops: No global throttles planned. We'll prefer routing and soft queueing. If regional pressure persists we'll communicate potential temporary rate-limiting to affected tenants with advance notice.

ops-bot: reminder: infra sync tomorrow 09:30 PT to finalize threshold numbers and customer comm templates. RSVP if you want a slot.

sasha: Thanks. Can someone add a note about analytics event naming so we can filter traffic for customers routed cross-region?

devops: Added: analytics will include labels: region_requested, region_served, fallback_reason. We'll publish the schema in the observability repo.

harry: Appreciate everyone. If you asked something and its not answered here ping me or @devops directly. Will post a short summary to the all-hands notes.
